# V0.8.15

Section: Source

**V0.8.15** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on August 17th, 2019.

## V0.8.15

- Fix - Resolved crash due to ball-and-socket joints
- Fix - Added arrows to pipe blocks
- Fix - Resolved water rendering incorrectly inside boats
